# thebrightbyte.com

> The BrightByte (The BrightByte Capital LLC, USA) builds compliance-first AI systems for regulated industries and makes two software products: Revanta, sports club software, and Regfo, an AI regulatory workspace for biotech.

## Revanta — sports club software
Revanta is sports club software by The BrightByte — registration, ticketing, fan loyalty and facility booking for clubs, academies and rinks. It is modular: one profile per person (player, parent, fan, renter) across every product.

- [Revanta on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/revanta-sports)
- [Revanta platform](https://thebrightbyte.com/revanta): overview of all Revanta products for clubs, academies, spectator clubs and rinks.
- [Revanta SportSchool — youth sports registration and club software](https://thebrightbyte.com/revanta/youth-sports-club-software): registration and fee collection, tryouts and team formation, practice and game scheduling, field and rink allocation, player development (season plans, drill library, testing), in-house leagues, player documents, family communication. For youth clubs, academies, leagues and associations.
- [Revanta Loyalty — sports CRM, ticketing and fan loyalty](https://thebrightbyte.com/revanta/sports-crm): tickets and season passes sold in the club's own system, fan profile with attendance and purchase history, points, tiers and achievements, promo codes, gift cards and vouchers, segments, push and email campaigns, full data export. For professional, semi-pro, minor league and college clubs.
- [Revanta Venues — rink and sports facility management software](https://thebrightbyte.com/revanta/sports-facility-software): one calendar for seasons, classes and events, facility rental booking and confirmation, memberships, in-house leagues, public skate sessions sold by time slot with capacity limits and QR tickets, QR check-in, utilization, revenue and idle-hours reports. For ice rinks, arenas, sports complexes and rec centers.
- [Revanta Sites — sports club website platform](https://thebrightbyte.com/revanta/sports-club-website): news, fixtures and scores, rosters and player stats, club history and sponsors managed as data and published without developers.
- [Revanta e-com — merch store platform for sports clubs](https://thebrightbyte.com/revanta/club-merch-store): catalog with size and color variants, stock, orders, match-day promotions, click-and-collect, one customer record shared with tickets and loyalty.

### What Revanta does not do
- No mobile wallet with a stored balance.
- No card-linked rewards for purchases at sponsors.
- No ready-made plug-ins for US ticketing or POS systems; connections to an existing system are built per project.
- Not a sportsbook or betting CRM.

### Rollout and pricing
- Standard SaaS setup takes about two weeks and starts in the current season.
- Pricing depends on the modules and the size of the organization; quotes are given after a demo.

## Regfo — AI regulatory workspace for biotech
- [Regfo](https://regfo.com): parses 24 ICH guidelines and 1,054 compliance rules, 46+ data points per study, compliance scoring 0–100 and gap detection for preclinical teams.

## AI engineering for regulated industries
- Compliance baked into architecture from day one (audit trails, explainability, data governance), not bolted on after launch.
- 50+ projects shipped since 2018 across 5+ regulated industries.
- AI agent development for regulated workflows (KYC/AML, document processing, workflow automation with audit trails).
- RAG systems over sensitive data (HIPAA-compliant, SOC 2-ready, with citations and access controls).
- LLM fine-tuning for domain-specific compliance use cases.
- Industries: FinTech (PCI DSS, DORA), Biotech & Pharma (FDA, ICH), Healthcare (HIPAA), Legal & Field Services.
- Frameworks: EU AI Act, DORA, HIPAA, SOC 2 Type II, PCI DSS, FDA / ICH, 21 CFR Part 11.
